evals.expected_output: Agent authenticates context via jira me, lists issues assigned to current user excluding Done, uses --plain (or --raw), does not invent keys, does not open TUI.

assertions.description: Command plan uses $(jira me) and/or JQL currentUser() for assignee, not a hardcoded personal username
Filter excludes Done/resolved work (-s~Done or resolution/status JQL)
No fabricated issue keys are presented as real results without a CLI read
Does not use nonexistent --output json flag

evals.expected_output: Agent treats ACME-42 as given key, confirms before transition, does not call move --list, runs jira issue move ACME-42 "In Progress" (after optional status read).

assertions.description: Asks user for confirmation before executing move/create/comment/assign
Never uses jira issue move --list or claims that flag exists
Uses jira issue move ACME-42 with quoted/exact state In Progress
Does not substitute a different org-specific project key for ACME-42

evals.prompt: Comment on PROJ-99: shipped in abc123 — use a short markdown bullet list of verification steps
evals.expected_output: Confirms, converts markdown via pandoc -f gfm -t jira when pandoc available, posts via jira issue comment add PROJ-99 … --no-input or --template.

assertions.description: Confirms with user before posting comment
Uses pandoc -f gfm -t jira (or documents plain-text fallback if pandoc missing) for structured markdown
Uses jira issue comment add PROJ-99
Passes --no-input and/or --template to avoid TUI prompt

evals.prompt: List high-priority bugs in project OPS updated this week that are not done
evals.expected_output: Cross-project capable command using -pOPS (or JQL project=OPS), type Bug, priority High, updated week, status not Done, plain columns.

assertions.description: Applies bug type, high priority, and updated/created week-style filter
Does not assume skill author's default project; OPS is explicit

evals.prompt: Add a GitHub issue for the login bug
evals.expected_output: Skill must NOT be the right tool; agent should not run jira CLI for a pure GitHub Issues request.

assertions.description: Does not invoke jira CLI for a GitHub Issues-only request
Treats this as outside jira skill scope (GitHub/gh, not Jira)
